title: Figure 9: Tunable Casimir effect - conductor vs. dielectric energy per unit area
description: Line plot of energy per unit area (x 10^10 J/m^2, 0 to 30, inverted axis) versus plate spacing d (0.5-1.0 μm), comparing a curve labeled "K = 4" (dielectric) with a steeper curve labeled "conductor". Caption: "Figure 9. Tunable Casimir Effect: Conductor vs. Dielectric."
